column1: 20073§grunt§ɡrʌnt§Long before the first caveman slumped down beside the fire and grunted news that there were plenty of wildebeest over yonder, our ancestors had learnt the value of sending out scouts to investigate the unknown.§早在第一个穴居人倚在火堆旁，**咕哝着说出**那边有许多牛羚的消息之前，我们的祖先就已经知晓派出侦察员探索未知领域的重要性。§
20074§regional§ˈriːdʒənl§Our group won the regional championship.§我们小组赢得了**地区**冠军。§改例句：champion 指冠军选手，“赢得冠军”应为 win the championship
20075§secure§sɪˈkjʊə(r)§The person won his eighth Olympic gold medal, and secured his place in history.§那个人赢得了他的第八块奥运会金牌，**巩固**了其历史地位。§
20076§preserve§prɪˈzɜːv§As a doctor, my profession is to preserve life, and to prevent disease from developing.§身为一名医生，我的职责是**保护**生命以及阻止疾病恶化。§
20077§reject§rɪˈdʒekt§They are cheap because they are rejects.§它们是**不合格品**，所以便宜。§
20078§code§kəʊd§What is the postal code for Black Street?§布莱克街的**邮编**是多少？§
20079§seek§siːk§They sought in vain for somewhere to shelter.§他们怎么也**找**不到藏身之处。§
20080§item§ˈaɪtəm§You should pay for each item the doctor has prescribed.§你需要为医生列出的各**项**处方付款。§
20081§effort§ˈefət§Henry has put a lot of effort into communicating with new friends.§亨利非常**努力**地与新朋友进行交流。§
20082§point§pɔɪnt§A: I'd like to give a lecture. What do you think? B: Well, short and to the point.§A: 我想做个演讲。你认为如何？B: 唔，注意要简短且紧扣**主题**。§改例句：问看法应说 What do you think，How 用词错；改译文：原译文末多出排版残留“针）”，删去
20083§review§rɪˈvjuː§Before going to bed, please review the day's classes.§睡觉前，请**复习**一下白天的课程内容。§
20084§fabrication§ˌfæbrɪˈkeɪʃn§The paper is a pure fabrication.§这篇论文纯粹是**无稽之谈**。§
20085§series§ˈsɪəriːz§This series of lectures is organized by the Students' Union.§这**一系列**演讲由学生会组织。§
20086§variation§ˌveəriˈeɪʃn§Variations and combinations of these two hat shapes formed the basis of the pupil's final designs.§这两种帽子外形的**改变**和相互融合构成了那个小学生最终设计的基础。§
20087§margin§ˈmɑːdʒɪn§I've made some suggestions in the margins.§我在**页边空白**处写了一些建议。§
20088§distraction§dɪˈstrækʃn§There are a lot of distractions at home.§家里有很多**让人分心的事**。§
20089§complicate§ˈkɒmplɪkeɪt§This problem was complicated beyond all reason.§这个问题被毫无道理地**复杂化**了。§
20090§tram§træm§I am watching for my tram because sometimes it comes early.§我正留意我要坐的那班**有轨电车**，因为它有时候会早到。§
20091§maturity§məˈtʃʊərəti§Almost all the fertilized eggs will hatch out into chicks which will in turn reach maturity.§几乎所有受精蛋都会孵出幼鸟，然后幼鸟会慢慢**长大**。§
20092§download§ˌdaʊnˈləʊd§Did they download the song from the Internet?§他们从网上**下载**的这首歌吗？§
20093§refer§rɪˈfɜː(r)§In his speech, Martin referred to education reform several times.§马丁在他的演讲中几次**提到**教育改革的问题。§
20094§interview§ˈɪntəvjuː§We will talk about how applicants are put through a short interview.§我们将讨论求职者如何进行简短的**面试**。§改例句：put through 在此应为被动，缺 are
20095§extent§ɪkˈstent§That old race track in the sport centre is nearly six miles in extent.§体育中心的旧跑道将近六英里**长**。§
20096§stint§stɪnt§The students were each given a stint of three chapters to read before the next seminar.§下次研讨课之前，每个学生都分到了三章的阅读**定量**。§补例句
20097§evacuate§ɪˈvækjueɪt§The hotel's fire officer will instruct you in how to evacuate the building if a fire breaks out.§旅馆的消防人员会告诉你们万一着火该如何**撤离**。§
20098§embankment§ɪmˈbæŋkmənt§It was the Tilburg architect Jo Hurkmans who hit on the idea of making use of noise embankments on main roads.§正是蒂尔堡的建筑师约·胡尔克曼斯灵机一动，想到在主干道上使用防噪音**路基**的办法。§
20099§squash§skwɒʃ§The new gym has got an ice rink and a sports hall for squash, badminton, volleyball and several other indoor sports.§新体育馆设有溜冰场和一个可以打**壁球**、羽毛球、排球和进行其他室内运动的运动大厅。§
20100§federation§ˌfedəˈreɪʃn§A study by the European Federation for Transport found that car transport is seven times as costly as rail travel.§欧洲运输**联盟**的一项研究发现，汽车运输所需的费用是铁路运输费用的七倍。§
20101§surge§sɜːdʒ§Magma had surged into the volcano from the Earth's mantle.§岩浆从地幔流出，**涌入**火山。§
20102§physical§ˈfɪzɪkl§The Physical Fitness Instructor's course is offered as a six-month course.§该**健身**教练的课程为期六个月。§改例句：sixmonth 拼写错，应为 six-month
20103§justify§ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ§To justify this claim, the arguer provided a lot of evidence.§为了**证明**这个主张是正当的，论证者提供了许多证据。§
20104§cooperation§kəʊˌɒpəˈreɪʃn§The President's visit has promoted the cooperation between the two countries.§那位总统的访问促进了两国间的**合作**。§
20105§score§skɔː(r)§The composition was scored with corrections in red ink.§这篇作文用红笔修正过并**打了分**。§
20106§persuade§pəˈsweɪd§I had tried my best to persuade Bob to join the club.§我竭尽全力**说服**鲍勃加入俱乐部。§
20107§migration§maɪˈgreɪʃn§The migration patterns of animals are related to the number of the kind of animal.§动物的**迁徙**方式与其种群的数量相关。§
20108§overweight§ˌəʊvəˈweɪt§Being overweight is a reason why back pain becomes worse.§**超重**负荷是导致背部疼痛加剧的一个原因。§
20109§stamp§stæmp§You'll have to get this card stamped and then you come back here with it and pay your union fee.§你先拿这张卡去**盖章**，然后拿着它返回这里交会费。§
20110§whistle§ˈwɪsl§This is where you whistle so the key holder will open the door for you.§你在这里**吹口哨**，这样看门人就会给你开门。§
20111§detective§dɪˈtektɪv§The detective tailed the man.§**侦探**盯上了那名男子。§
20112§occupy§ˈɒkjupaɪ§Any individual in any situation occupies a role in relation to other people.§任何个体，无论处于何种环境下，都**扮演**着与他人相关联的某种角色。§
20113§ceremony§ˈserəməni§The graduation ceremony in many universities is an important occasion.§在很多大学，毕业**典礼**都是重要的场合。§
20114§diagnose§ˈdaɪəgnəʊz§Lupus can be difficult to diagnose because symptoms vary from person to person.§狼疮很难**诊断**，因为其症状因人而异。§
20115§denote§dɪˈnəʊt§The uniforms denoted a hierarchy.§这些制服**体现**了一种等级关系。§
20116§chink§tʃɪŋk§Closer inspection revealed a chink of sky-light through the window.§走近点儿看就会发现有**一缕**自然光透过窗户射入。§改例句：单数可数名词 window 前缺冠词，补 the
20117§iris§ˈaɪrɪs§Systems using fingerprints, hands, voices, irises, retinas and faces are already on the market.§使用指纹、手掌、声音、**虹膜**、视网膜以及面部进行识别的系统都已上市。§
20118§resource§rɪˈsɔːs§How these countries can advance their economies without destroying their natural resources is a burning question.§如何既发展经济又不破坏自然**资源**是这些国家面临的一个迫在眉睫的问题。§

20119§entire§ɪnˈtaɪə(r)§Hughes claims that in the twenty-first century, consumers will be encouraged to think more about the entire history of the products and services they buy.§休斯声称，21世纪消费者将受到鼓励多考虑他们所购买的产品和服务的**整个**历史。§
20120§epitomise§ɪˈpɪtəmaɪz§Indeed, in many respects the Siriono epitomise the popular conception of life in Amazonia.§的确，西里奥诺人的生活在很多方面**集中体现**了亚马孙河流域普遍的生活理念。§
20121§summit§ˈsʌmɪt§A gigantic explosion tore much of the volcano's summit to fragments.§巨大的爆炸几乎将火山**山顶**全部炸成碎片。§
20122§ensure§ɪnˈʃʊə(r)§How can you ensure that your diet contains enough of the vitamins you need?§你怎样才能**确保**你的饮食中包含了自己所需的足量的维生素呢？§
20123§odour§ˈəʊdə(r)§Some people are known as odour-blind.§一些人闻不到**气味**。§
20124§accurate§ˈækjərət§The forecast was soon proved accurate.§不久，预言就被证明是**正确**的。§
20125§superior§suːˈpɪəriə(r)§Researchers found that a word without a picture is superior to a word plus a picture in terms of reading efficiency.§研究人员发现，就阅读效率而言，不配图画的文字比配有图画的文字的阅读效率**更高**。§
20126§tender§ˈtendə(r)§Chicken is tender and delicious.§鸡肉肉**嫩**味美。§
20127§willing§ˈwɪlɪŋ§Would you be willing to attend any of our promotions?§你**愿意**参加我们的任何一个宣传活动吗？§
20128§perform§pəˈfɔːm§Why did the divers perform worse in colder conditions?§为什么在较冷的条件下潜水者会**表现**得差些呢？§
20129§seep§siːp§Some parts of Australia are dry because rainwater seeps quickly through sandy soils and into the rock below.§澳大利亚的一些地区非常干燥，因为雨水很快**渗过**砂土，进入下面的岩石层。§
20130§delinquency§dɪˈlɪŋkwənsi§Network is becoming the hotbed of juvenile delinquency.§网络正成为青少年**犯罪**的温床。§
20131§deliberate§dɪˈlɪbərət§Wilson has a slow, deliberate way of acting.§威尔逊动作缓慢而**谨慎**。§
20132§implication§ˌɪmplɪˈkeɪʃn§What would be the implications if humanity were to understand, with precision, the genetic constitution?§如果人类准确破译了基因的构成，那将**意味着**什么呢？§
20133§opponent§əˈpəʊnənt§The American Medical Association represents about half of all U.S. doctors and is a strong opponent of smoking.§美国医学协会代表着全美一半左右的医生，这一机构强烈**反对**吸烟。§
20134§sponsor§ˈspɒnsə(r)§He is the main sponsor of the conference.§他是这次会议的主要**发起者**。§
20135§decisive§dɪˈsaɪsɪv§Automobiles and televisions have the most decisive influences on people's habits.§汽车和电视对人们的生活习惯最具**决定性**的影响。§
20136§substantial§səbˈstænʃl§The smoke experienced daily by many people is enough to produce substantial adverse effects on the heart and lungs.§很多人日常所吸入的（香烟）烟雾就足以对他们的心脏和肺产生**巨大**的副作用。§
20137§questionnaire§ˌkwestʃəˈneə(r)§They did a lot of research using questionnaires.§他们借助**调查问卷**进行了大量研究。§
20138§viewpoint§ˈvjuːpɔɪnt§They held obstinately to the purely military viewpoint.§他们顽固地坚持纯粹的军事**观点**。§
20139§routine§ruːˈtiːn§Physical fitness instructors prepare routines of exercises to suit the individual client's age and level of fitness.§健身教练根据每位顾客的年龄及健康状况为他们量身打造锻炼**计划**。§
20140§nurture§ˈnɜːtʃə(r)§We need to seek and nurture new talents.§我们需要发掘和**培养**新人才。§
20141§slight§slaɪt§I had a slight headache this morning.§今天早上我**有点**头疼。§
20142§genetic§dʒəˈnetɪk§Genetic inheritance determines a baby's characteristics.§**遗传**基因决定了婴儿的特征。§
20143§similarly§ˈsɪmələli§All students in this school wear similarly unconventionally-cut suits.§这所学校所有的学生都穿着剪裁新颖、款式**相同**的服装。§
